pages.title: Divination
pages.text: To make it easier to get started, the materials obtained by divination now also have crafting recipes.$(br)$(bold)If you want the full experience, skip the following recipe page and move on to the$(br)divination instructions.$()$(br)

Otherworld materials play an important role in interacting with spirits.$(br)As they are rare and not visible to the naked eye, finding them requires special tools.$(br)The divination rod allows to find Otherworld materials based on their $()
similarities to materials common to our world.$(br)

The divination rod uses a spirit attuned gem attached to a wooden rod.$(br)The gem resonates with the chosen material, and this movement is amplified by the wooden rod,$(br)allowing to detect nearby Otherworld materials.    $()
$(br2)    $(br)The rod works by detecting resonance between real world and Otherworld materials.$(br)Attuned the rod to a real world material, and it will find the corresponding Otherworld block.$()
$(br)

pages.title: Use of the Rod
pages.text: $(#ad03fc)Shift-right-click$() a block to attune the rod to the corresponding Otherworld block.$(br)$(li)$(item)andesite$(): $(item)Otherstone$()$(br)$(li)$(item)oak wood$():  $(item)Otherworld Log$()$(br)$(li)$(item)leaves$(): $(item)Otherworld Leaves$()$()

pages.title: Use of the Rod
pages.text: $(br)$(li)$(item)netherrack$(): $(item)Iesnium Ore$()$(br2)Then $(#ad03fc)right-click$() and hold until the rod animation finishes.

After the animation finishes, a particle will fly toward the closest found block.$(br)Additionally you can watch the crystals for hints: a white crystal indicates no target blocks found,$(br)a fully purple block means the found block is $()
nearby. Mixes between white and purple show$(br)that the target is rather far away.

$(#ad03fc)Right-clicking$() without holding after a successful search will send another particle toward the last found target block.$(br2)If you prefer the old target highlight, open occultism-client.toml and set $()
useAlternativeDivinationRodRenderer = true.$(br)
White means nothing was found.$(br)The more purple you see, the closer you are.$(br)

pages.title: Otherworld Groves
pages.text: Otherworld Groves are lush, overgrown caves, with $(#ad03fc)Otherworld Trees$(),$(br)and walls of $(item)Otherstone$(), and represent the fastest way to get everything one$(br)needs to get set up as a summoner.$(br)To find them, attune your divination rod to $()

pages.title: Otherworld Groves
pages.text: Otherworld leaves$(br)or logs, as unlike Otherstone, they only spawn in these groves.$(br)
$(bold)Hint:$() In the Overworld, look $(bold)down$().$(br)

pages.title: Otherworld Trees
pages.text: Otherworld trees grow naturally in Otherworld Groves. To the naked eye they appear as oak trees,$(br)but to the Third Eye they reveal their true nature.    $(br)$(bold)Important:$() Otherworld Saplings can only be obtained by breaking the $()

pages.title: Otherworld Trees
pages.text: leaves manually, naturally only oak saplings drop.$(br)
Trees grown from Stable Otherworld Saplings as obtained from spirit traders do not have that limitation.$(br)

pages.title: Extra Config
pages.text: An additional function of the Divination Rod is to locate any ore,$(br) however this is not a default function and needs to be enabled,$(br) as we recommend using the Greedy familiar or Theurgy mod for this type of divination.$(br) If you want to $()

pages.title: Extra Config
pages.text: enable this feature directly in Occultism Divination Rod, check$(br) "Server Configuration > Items" and set "Divination c:ores" to "on".$(br)
